# Runbook: team-frontend

| Namespace | `marketplace` (local), `marketplace-staging` (staging on kind) (edge only, with a kind overlay) |
| Port | 3000 (container port) |
| Health | HTTP `/` |
| Image tag | `platform-gitops/envs/<env>/values.yaml` -> `images.team-frontend` |

## Dependencies
- none declared beyond the cluster itself

## Alerts that can point here
- none specific. `HighErrorRate`/`HighLatencyP95` are measured at the gateway and can be caused by this service; `ServiceDown` only covers scraped jobs (team-ai, otel-collector).
Alert delivery in the local stack: Alertmanager -> `webhook-logger` (`kubectl -n marketplace logs deploy/webhook-logger`). See `docs/runbooks/alerts.md`.

## Triage
1. `kubectl -n marketplace get pods -l app=team-frontend` then `kubectl -n marketplace describe pod -l app=team-frontend | tail -30` (probe failures, OOMKilled, image pull).
2. `kubectl -n marketplace logs deploy/team-frontend --tail=200`: look for dependency errors from the list above.
3. Check the dependencies first (`kubectl -n marketplace get pods`), then this service.
4. Recent change? `kubectl -n argocd get application team-frontend -o wide` and compare `images.team-frontend` with the previous tag in git.

## Rollback
Plain Deployment (no canary). Revert the tag in git, then publish:
`scripts/rollback.sh team-frontend --env local --to <good-tag> && make -C deploy gitops-push`
(this edits `images.team-frontend`; with `--env staging` for the staging overlay). A bare `kubectl rollout undo` is reverted by ArgoCD selfHeal.
